name: Book Employee with Spouse — Cancel Existing Appointment
goal: User chooses to cancel an existing appointment for employee with spouse.
constraints: Eligibility mode is 'manage'. User selects 'Cancel appointment'.

phases.description: Bot presents reschedule/cancel options; user selects cancel.
Bot processes cancellation and confirms to user.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot confirms cancellation and offers further help.

manualPrereqs: Chrome must be open and logged into Google Chat as the test user
